description_en: Analyzes the lineage (dependencies and influence) between tables and between fields in SQL statements
description_zh: 分析SQL语句中的表、字段之间的血缘关系（依赖和影响关系）
name: AnalyzeSQLLineage

parameters.help_en:
The database ID.

You can call one of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html, and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141869.html operations to obtain the database ID provided in the DatabaseId response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
数据库ID。
该参数对应https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141869.html等接口中的DatabaseId参数，您可以调用上述任一接口获取数据库ID
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.example: insert into a (id) select id from b;
parameters.name: sql_content

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

To view the tenant ID, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

LineageResult.description_en: Returned data set of SQL lineage

LineageType.description_en:
The type of the lineage. Valid values:

FIELD_DEPEND_FIELD: Fields depend on fields.
TABLE_DEPEND_TABLE: Tables depend on tables.
FIELD_INFLU_TABLE: Fields influence tables.
FIELD_INFLU_FIELD: Fields influence fields.
FIELD_INFLU_TABLE: Tables influence fields.
FIELD_JOIN_FIELD: Fields are associated with fields
LineageType.description_zh:
血缘关系类型，取值和说明如下：
FIELD_DEPEND_FIELD：字段依赖字段。
TABLE_DEPEND_TABLE：表依赖表。
FIELD_INFLU_TABLE：字段影响表。
FIELD_INFLU_FIELD：字段影响字段。
TABLE_INFLU_FIELD：表影响字段。
FIELD_JOIN_FIELD：字段关联字段

OperType.description_en:
The operation type of the SQL statement in which the data lineage is generated. For example, if the operation type is SELECT, the data lineage is generated from a SELECT statement.

This field is an extended field which has no practical use
OperType.description_zh:
操作类型，指产生血缘的位置。例如，操作类型为SELECT，则表示该血缘关系来源于SELECT语句。

该字段为扩展字段，暂无实际用途

ProcessDetail.description_en: The handling details. This parameter is returned only when LineageType is FIELD_DEPEND_FIELD
ProcessDetail.description_zh: 处理详情。仅字段来源字段关系（FIELD_DEPEND_FIELD）会存在此参数

CalWay.description_en:
The calculating method. Valid values:

DIRECT: No function or expression is used.
EXPR: A function or expression is used
CalWay.description_zh:
计算方式，取值和说明如下：
DIRECT：表示未经过任何函数或者表达式加工。
EXPR：表示经过函数或者表达式加工

Code.description_en: The SQL code snippet for field processing

ObjectMetadata.description_en: The table and field metadata information

Source.description_en:
The source of metadata. Valid values:

DDL: The metadata comes from parsed SQL statements or definition of databases and tables collected by DMS.
LINEAGE: The metadata comes from lineage analysis results
Source.description_zh:
元数据获取来源，取值和说明如下：
DDL：来源于SQL解析或DMS采集的库表元数据定义。
LINEAGE：来源于血缘解析的结果

Type.description_en:
The object type. Valid values:

TABLE
VIEW
TMP_TABLE
Type.description_zh:
对象类型，取值和说明如下：
TABLE：表。
VIEW：视图。
TMP_TABLE：临时表

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。返回值如下：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
